title: 菊花賞の後に・サイコーのレース！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While the competition between BNW is tight, Winning Ticket takes first place.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She wants to race against her rivals again soon, so with that in mind, we choose the likeliest place they'll be—the Osaka Hai.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, Narita Taishin and Biwa Hayahide are distant in their attitude toward Winning Ticket.
